description: Rule catalog. Each rule is evaluated by the Validation stage against a generated roster.

rules.name: coverage
rules.description: Every shift slot declared in the demand table must be assigned exactly the required headcount.

rules.name: qualification
rules.description: An employee may only be assigned to a role listed in that employee's skills.

rules.name: no_double_booking
rules.description: An employee may hold at most one assignment per calendar day.

rules.name: rest_between_shifts
rules.description: A night shift must not be immediately followed by a morning shift on the next day.

rules.name: max_consecutive_days
rules.description: An employee must not work more than max_days consecutive calendar days.

rules.name: weekly_hours
rules.description: Each employee's total assigned hours should fall within [min_weekly_hours, max_weekly_hours].

rules.name: fairness
rules.description: The spread between the busiest and the least busy employee should not exceed max_spread shifts.

rules.name: night_shift_quota
rules.description: No employee should be assigned more than max_nights night shifts across the planning horizon.
